message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Changelog Bot Trigger

on:
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check approved pull request
    if: >
      github.repository == 'openwisp/openwisp-radius' &&
      github.event.review.state == 'approved' &&
      (github.event.review.author_association == 'OWNER' ||
        github.event.review.author_association == 'MEMBER' ||
        github.event.review.author_association == 'COLLABORATOR')
    concurrency:
      group: changelog-trigger-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pinned changelog scripts
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: openwisp/openwisp-actions
          ref: d6cc603701fe96a84115b060d34e8844a969cc41 # 0.3.0
          path: openwisp-actions
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check for noteworthy PR
        id: check
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: bash openwisp-actions/.github/actions/bot-changelog-generator/caller/check_title.sh

      - name: Save PR metadata
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_noteworthy == 'true'
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: echo "$PR_NUMBER" > pr_number

      - name: Upload PR metadata
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_noteworthy == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: changelog-metadata
          path: pr_number
",
  "rationale": "Add a custom job timeout of 5 minutes to prevent runaway execution. The job performs a simple checkout and runs a bash script, which typically completes in seconds. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8) shows that adding a 5-minute timeout to similar jobs reduces elapsed time without affecting success rates. The workflow already includes concurrency with cancel-in-progress, which aligns with the cancel-superseded-runs pattern, so no further change is needed there.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
